//: The Microsoft Store build, merged over tauri.conf.json by `npm run desktop:build -- --variant msix`. Windows is unconstrained: an MSIX package declares runFullTrust, so this is the whole product with the injection engine in it (PRD §10.1, §10.2). Tauri has no MSIX target, so this produces the MSI payload that MSIX packaging wraps; validating the packaged artifact and its declared capabilities belongs to P04. Updates come from the store, so no updater artifact is produced — a self-updater inside a store package is a rejection, and a way to strand somebody on a version the store believes it already replaced.
